messages:
kai (product): quick sync - release board shows build pressure on milestone. proposal: keep MVP date but cut tenant-level routing and advanced retry logic to v1. MVP = core API + basic observability; v1 = routing, retries, tenant routing. Need thumbs and owners.
anya (eng): cutting routing removes ~1.5w of infra work from critical path. But retries are safety-critical for some customers. If we cut retries we need strong circuit-breaker metrics.
ben (eng-infra): we can ship without tenant routing by default and expose a manual enable for 2 pilot tenants. Ops cost for manual enable is ~2 engineer-hours per tenant for the first week. We should automate the toggle later.
morgan (pm): ACME pilot requires deterministic retries; without automated retry they want a documented contract. Can we offer a manual retry window + SLA marks in contract for pilot?
rachel (design): UX implications: removing routing simplifies admin UI. For MVP we can hide advanced routing options and add a "pilot enable" flow in settings for pilot tenants.
anya (eng): fallback plan: ship MVP with disabled advanced routing, but include a lightweight retry SDK flag clients can opt into. Server-side retry remains v1. That reduces infra exposure.
enkj (ops-bot): infra alert: deploy 9053 queued for release/mvp-cut. Preflight checks: schema-migrations OK, canary smoke pending.
ben (eng-infra): metrics we need: retry-success-rate, retry-induced-latency-p90, tenant-cold-start-rate. Set gating: if retry-induced-latency-p90 > 300ms we abort pilot.
morgan (pm): decision strawman: ship MVP on time without automated tenant routing and server-side retries; provide manual pilot enable for up to 2 customers and an SDK-side opt-in for client retries. v1 = automated tenant routing + server retries + UI. v1 buffer = +12 days.
kai (product): agree. Owners: anya -> SDK retry flag + gating metrics, ben -> manual enable runbook + canary, rachel -> hidden pilot UI & docs, morgan -> customer comms & contracts. I'll publish updated roadmap slice and ping legal.
ops-bot: canary deploy 9053 started. status: running.
anya (eng): will submit PR for SDK flag and perf harness by EOD. If synthetic canary shows >0.7% error spike we'll gate.
kai (product): action items: update milestone board, post customer comms draft, prepare pilot runbook. Decision recorded. :white_check_mark:
